content.title: Jump - 2015 Remaster

alternatives.text: "Jump," the iconic 1984 single from Van Halen's album of the same name, stands as a testament to the band's innovative spirit and David Lee Roth's lyrical ingenuity. The song's driving keyboard riff, coupled with Eddie Van Halen's signature guitar work and Alex Van Halen's precise drumming, creates a dynamic that propels the listener forward. The lyrics, while seemingly simple.
